finding.text: Bug 3 (the owner's words sent twice) is not fixed. The Router change (core/Router/Router.js:332, 309) only changes which page a message is labelled with after a navigation. It does not stop the second `say` POST. The evidence lines (evidence-session.sample.txt:72, 78, 88) show a second composer sending the dictated text `via: "text"`, and nothing in the diff finds or removes that composer.

The bug 3 proof does not test the setup the brief named. proof.mjs:194-214 runs one mount on the Dictate page with no ☰ drawer open on an ai2 page, so the "1 say" count it prints cannot catch the duplicate. The comment at proof.mjs:127-129 also gets the evidence wrong: three copies in the session file show three sends from the browser, not a "server-side triplicate".

Bug 2 (the "PAR" bubble) has no code change at all. The brief said to find the surface that draws it and fix it in one shared place. proof.mjs:182 only checks the ✦ sheet's text, and bug2-replay-no-par-400.png shows only the last bubbles of the replay. The ☰ drawer's AI tab, a card's ai2 chat and ext/Chat/Chat.js `draw()` were never checked.

Bug 4 (the sheet closing by itself) has no fix, and the proof is weaker than the brief asked for. task.jsonl line 5 admits it was never reproduced. proof.mjs:216-234 calls `router.go` with the mic off and dictates nothing, where the brief asked for the mic on, three sentences, and the drawer moving between two pages. bug4-sheet-survives-bounce-400.png shows the sheet open, but that was already true before the change.

Moving `navigated()` out of `activate()` (Router.js:123-140, App.js:291) moves a responsibility in core, and CLAUDE.md says to ask before doing that. It was also mostly unneeded: ext/drawer/rail.js:203-213 and :821-829 already wait one tick for `pushState`, and tabs.js does the same. Only rail.js:1163 (`this.mount?.nav(drawer.page(), …)`) reads the path without waiting. The simpler fix is to wrap that one call in the same `setTimeout`, and to revert the core change.

If the Router change does stay, the comments that describe the old order are now wrong: rail.js:198-213, rail.js:815-820, tabs.js's `navigated()`, and the `code` skill §7 trap. The new comments in Router.js and the three doc files are also far longer than the change, which goes against "keep it short".

Bug 1 (session-smart.md) does what was asked. The assistant answers first, never calls `list_agents`, looks up in-flight work only in asks.jsonl or task.jsonl line 1, and the `dir_log({dir, line: {…}})` shape is spelled out. Rule 1 could still lose its long parenthetical history to save prompt time. The report must also say the change only reaches NEW sessions; task.jsonl does not say so.

evidence-session.sample.txt is a renamed copy of the owner's session log, committed to get around the "never commit .jsonl" rule (proof.mjs:170-173). Its lines 101-108 are probe bubbles from a later test, not the owner's words. Load the real file at run time instead of committing a copy.

Bug 2 ("PAR" bubble) has no code change in the diff. `proof.mjs:142-170` only checks that "PAR" is absent now, so either it was already fixed on michael/dev (then name the commit that fixed it in the report) or nothing was fixed. As it stands, the brief's "find the surface that draws it" has no answer.

Bug 4 (the sheet closing by itself) has no code change either. The only rail.js edit (`rail.js:1170`) moves the chat's `nav()` call one tick later, and that changes which path a sentence is filed under, not whether the sheet closes. If the proof's `bug4.stayed_open` is true on the old code too, the proof never reproduced the owner's bug. Say which one it is, and fix the cause if it was never found.

Bug 3's proof does not use the setup the brief asked for. `proof.mjs:229` moves the main page with `router.go`; it never opens the ☰ drawer onto an ai2 page while the ✦ sheet stays on Dictate. It also skips the audio path (`say_sentence` → `log_prompt`, `flush` → `send_screen`), so a second composer whose box receives the same dictation by some other route can never show up in it. That is exactly the cause the brief suspected.

The `arm()` guard (`Mic.js:609-611`) is a reasonable fix for a mic stopped while a Whisper answer is still on its way. But the late words then stay in that mount's `held` and its box, unsent. The next time that mount's mic starts, they go out with whatever is said next, under the new page's path. Clearing them or sending them at once would be safer than leaving them in the box.

The evidence's duplicates are `via: "text"`, but `Session.js:68` `say()` defaults `via` to `"text"`. So that label does not prove that a typed send caused the duplicates. The report should say which call actually sent each duplicate.

The `session-smart.md` rule 1 rewrite and the `dir_log` call shape (lines 48-60 of the diff) do what the brief asked: answer first, a small source, never `list_agents`. Rule 1 is still one long paragraph; the parenthetical history ("the owner, 2026-10-01: an 8-minute silence…") could be cut to keep the prompt short.
No shots are in the diff (`minion-core/shots/` is missing), and no commit has the proof's printed `say` counts. The parent has nothing to check against without re-running `proof.mjs`.
